articles.title: Raptors fall to Knicks 111-102 for fifth straight loss
articles.summary: Jalen Brunson drilled a three-pointer with 1:25 left to play as the New York Knicks escaped with a 111-102 win over the Toronto Raptors on Tuesday for the second game in a row. Brunson had a game-high 31 points, including eight in the fourth quarter, as New York (8-6) again erased a 13-point Raptors lead […]

articles.title: 'Bring it on,' Mississauga mayor says as real estate firms appeal city's data centre ban
articles.summary: Mississauga's new mayor says he's prepared to fight against U.S-based Prologis and Montcrest Asset Management, two companies that are challenging the city's decision to block a data centre project at the Ontario Land Tribunal.

articles.title: Pedestrian taken to hospital with serious injuries after being struck by vehicle in Scarborough
articles.summary: Paramedics tell CityNews they’ve taken a man to a local trauma centre with serious, non life-threatening injuries after he was struck by a vehicle in Scarborough on Tuesday evening. articles.summary: Two people have been taken to hospital after a collision between a motorcycle and a minivan in Mississauga Tuesday afternoon. articles.title: Inquest into death of Jamal Francique, who was shot by police in Mississauga in 2020 paused for a day
articles.summary: The coroner's inquest into the death of a Black man shot by police in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago is on hold for a day. The presiding officer says counsel are dealing with the proposed submission of new material not previously provided to the inquest.

articles.title: SIU investigating after Durham police involved in crash at Hwy 401 ramp
articles.summary: A 53-year-old woman has a serious, non-life threatening injury after a three-vehicle collision involving a police vehicle in Whitby on Sunday, the province's police watchdog says.

articles.title: U of T's plan to address discrimination against Muslims, Arabs, Palestinians 'insufficient': prof
articles.summary: The University of Toronto's plans to address discrimination against Muslims, Arabs and Palestinians on its campuses are "wholly insufficient," says the author of a report that found the school has a "general pattern of over-policing and under-protecting" these groups.

articles.title: 12 men charged in Peel auto theft bust after 96 vehicles recovered from shipping containers
articles.summary: Twelve men have been arrested after Peel Regional Police say they recovered 96 stolen vehicles, worth an estimated $4.5 million, from shipping containers destined for West Africa.
